question: Does an early-fit compact affine oracle predict disjoint future endpoints or causal one-step tangents of the accepted co-adapted late-c_proj path?

repair_scope.only_change: replace exact-arithmetic tolerances with forward-error bounds for long FP32 Givens chains

numerical_analysis.cumulative_radius_bound: 2373 updates times 88 staged Givens rotations gives about 208824 local transformations; the conservative first-order gamma bound is about 0.0249, rounded upward to 0.03
numerical_analysis.last_step_replay_bound: one inverse plus forward replay traverses 176 staged rotations; a conservative constant-factor float32 accumulation allowance is 3e-5
numerical_analysis.scientific_interpretation: Observed errors below these independent bounds validate mechanics; they do not improve any endpoint or tangent recovery score.

analysis.radial_normalization: normalize each weight to its observed step-zero Frobenius norm after checking cumulative drift against the FP32 forward-error bound
analysis.endpoint_basis: through-step-zero PCA of normalized discovery endpoint displacements
analysis.tangent_basis: through-origin PCA of reconstructed normalized discovery last-update tangents

functional_metric.model_state: accepted terminal full-state snapshot at step 2373

analysis.monitoring: direct foreground polling; no watchdog or callback

outcomes.PREDICTIVE_ENDPOINT_AND_CAUSAL_TANGENT_O: Integrated endpoints and causal functional tangents are both predictable; next design must still use a paper-style fixed random/modulated map, never this learned oracle.
outcomes.SMOOTH_ENDPOINT_WITH_NONTRANSPORTABLE_TA: Integrated endpoints are compact but local directions remain state-conditioned; only nonlinear or modulated state-dependent mapping theory remains open.
outcomes.FUNCTION_SPACE_ENDPOINT_WITHOUT_WEIGHT_C: Only a task-metric quotient is compact; identify a fixed analytic metric before any structure.
outcomes.LOCAL_FUNCTIONAL_TANGENT_WITHOUT_ENDPOIN: Local directions are predictable but do not integrate into one affine chart.
outcomes.NO_PREDICTIVE_FIXED_AFFINE_CHART: Close the fixed affine chart family.
